_about: The M8 manual-catalog pass, set up like the Elekloader kit's devices.json. The M8 manual has no numbered headings, so every part gives explicit ranges (lines of manuals/m8.txt, pdftotext -layout of the v20260421 manual).

m8.name: Dirtywave M8 (Model:02)
m8.notes: The M8 is a tracker: eight monophonic tracks, a Song > Chain > Phrase hierarchy, tables, three FX-command columns per row, instruments with four modulators each, and a mixer with send effects. The manual describes OS 6.5.2; the firmware the mods target is 6.6.2.

A.title: Panel, navigation, system, storage, MIDI, USB, sampling
A.covers: panel, key shortcuts, project, settings, theme, MIDI, render, sample editor, USB
A.focus: Also read the panel material here as the panel lens would: every key combination and navigation rule, hex entry, and the troubleshooting behaviours. The Sample Editor and Render/Selection-to-Sample are sampling targets: use the sampling layer for them.
ranges: Conventions; Overview; Physical layout; Power; Audio out; microSD; Getting started; Navigation; Key shortcuts; Hexadecimal; Firmware updates; Demo song
Project; System Settings; Theme; MIDI Mapping; MIDI Settings; Time Stats; Render; Selection to Sample; Effect Command Help
USB Features; Troubleshooting; Key Shortcuts appendix

B.title: The tracker: song, live mode, chains, phrases, tables, groove, scales, sequencer FX commands
B.covers: song, live mode, chain, phrase, instrument pool, table, groove, scale views and the sequencer FX commands
B.focus: The FX-command appendix is the M8's main extension surface: one row per command (or per distinct behaviour), using the fx-commands layer, and say for each whether adding a sibling command is a natural extend.
ranges: Views; Song View; Live Mode; Chain View; Phrase View
Instrument Pool; Table View; Groove View; Scale View
Relative and Absolute FX Commands; Sequencer FX Commands

C.title: Instruments, modulation and the synth engines
C.covers: instrument and modulation views, wavsynth, macrosynth, sampler, FM, hypersynth, external instrument, MIDI out, instrument FX commands
C.focus: The modulation view is the priority: modulator types, the destination list per engine, amounts, triggers and ranges; extending the destination list (for example to the mixer sends) is a key extend target. The Macrosynth Models and Wavsynth wave table index are long lists: one row per list, not per entry.
ranges: FM Synth; Hypersynth; External Instrument; MIDI Out

D.title: Mixer, EQ, limiter and send effects
D.covers: mixer, EQ editor, limiter and mix scope, effect settings, mixer and effects FX commands
D.focus: The send effects (chorus/modfx, delay, reverb) and the master path are the targets for performance mods that apply effects to the master: list every send, every effect parameter and every master-stage control as its own decision point.
ranges: Mixer View; EQ Editor; Limiter & Mix Scope; Effect Settings
